prompts.prompt: Using our Human instance, build me a page that shows our contacts grouped by whether they are active, as one HTML file I can look at. Just give me the HTML at the end.
Make me a small dashboard of the tasks in our Human agent sandbox: how many per priority, and the next ones coming due. One HTML file, give me the HTML at the end.
I need a page listing our companies from Human with how many contacts each one has and who they are. One HTML file please, HTML at the end.

Build a contacts table page from our Human data. It should let me export the table to CSV and remember which filter I picked last time, and open each contact's email in a new tab. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
